model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for per-specialty terms across six medical specialties, comparing the base Mistralv0.2 model against fine-tuned versions on each specialty. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms,” lists the six specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—in left-to-right order. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -27 to -22. The chart displays grouped bars for each specialty, with each group containing seven bars representing the different fine-tuned models: Cardio (light beige), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown), as indicated by the legend. Each group shows a consistent pattern where the base Mistralv0.2-Base model (light blue bar) is significantly shorter (i.e., has a higher negative log probability value) than the fine-tuned models, which are all longer (i.e., have lower negative log probability values). For example, in the Cardio group, the base model bar reaches approximately -26.8, while the fine-tuned bars range from about -25.5 to -26.0. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the specialties listed on the x-axis. There are no visual emphasis or annotations on any specific bar.
